sourceInformation.tech: my-3D2dge v0.89.1 with boot-path fix; AI Hub protocol 1 / client 1.4.0; JavaScript, Canvas 2D, Web Audio, WebRTC; Bun 1.3.14 build
sourceInformation.artDirection: Original code-drawn shaded pixel art: moonflowers, copper clockwork gardeners, striped insects and luminous wings
sourceInformation.animation: Custom insect and gardener rigs extend native E.Blob spring/wing state; native actor sorting, shapes, particles and pixel primitives
sourceInformation.audio: Original procedural garden score, synthesized effects and Animalese-style oscillator chatter; no audio files; music defaults to 10%
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub host-authoritative shared world; standalone manual WebRTC offer/answer; simultaneous couch co-op
sourceInformation.testing: Unrestricted headless testing, scripted normal-command campaign playthroughs, Chromium/WebKit/Firefox, emulated standard pads and touch, native headless drawing, offline audio and live bus analysis, real Hub harness and two-context WebRTC. Physical devices, public Internet connectivity and subjective listening were unavailable.
sourceInformation.research: Original U.S. manual; two Bob Harris creator interviews; engine handoff and Hub contract. Gameplay videos were located but not viewed/heard; exact source sound is unknown.

testingFeedback: 6 distinct defects caught and fixed; test-fixture and floating-point assertion corrections are recorded separately.
1 critical issue: the upstream boot:false path prevented leaving the title. It is fixed.
The ordinary-command whole-campaign replay, combined with shared-world harness checks: it verified real completion and caught contact ordering and lifecycle defects.

An unbound synthetic pointer event for touch cancellation was less useful than actual browser touch events; it did not represent an active touch. Replaced it with valid cancellation and CDP multitouch tests.
engineFeedback: Native shaded shapes, procedural rigs and a single deterministic update loop make a coherent code-drawn game possible.
The boot:false path left _booting set, blocking scene transitions. Native expand sizing also needed explicit arena containment, including paused resize handling.
The deterministic swarm simulation, contact rules, campaign content and transport-independent host authority.
Fitting one unchanged arena around HUD and touch safe areas while keeping native pixel art readable.
Patched one engine line: boot:false clears _booting before returning to start. Otherwise Play remains on the title. All other game systems extend native APIs; the Hub SDK is pristine.
A built-in arena-fit helper with HUD and touch insets would simplify fixed-screen games.
promptFeedback: The combat, network and completion contracts are specific enough to verify.
PLAN.md names a different intended model; TASK.md supplies the actual run attribution and filenames.
Combining normal-rule campaign completion, controller-first presentation and real host-authoritative multiplayer in one portable file.
Separate mandatory acceptance checks from suggested implementation examples and give the network harness a minimal project adapter.

aiHub.name: Killer Bee-yond Midnight
aiHub.description: Lead twelve luminous bees through six moonlit garden encounters. Sting clockwork gardeners, turn their shells into routes, and earn horizontal rays to sweep away rival swarms — solo or together.
aiHub.controls: WASD/arrows or left stick to steer; Shift/R2 to Focus; Space/Cross to fire ray; Esc/Options to pause. Touch: left drag, right hold, Ray tap.
